title: Kanary
body:
## 📚 **Information**
This is a modpack focused on optimizing Minecraft for all its modloaders and versions, using mods from different creators. It also replaces some features from [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/home).

## ✨ **Features**
- Main menu Optimizations
- Server Optimizacions
- Render Optimizations
- Bug Fixes

## ✅ **Beneficts**
- Higher FPS in-game
- Lower RAM usage
- Server Ping Optimization

## 💎 **OptiFine Replaced Features**
- Dynamic Lights
- Capes
- Zoom
- HD Screenshots
- Shaders
- Advanced Video Settings
- Resource Packs Enhancements
